title: 第7章 四方势力蠢蠢欲动第8章 降临真武圣地
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 上界
三千大世界凌家
虚空穿梭阵
两名外门长老自此等候凌浩到来
硕大的广场中央处，聚集上千名凌家弟子，都在等凌浩的到来，毕竟凌家神子不是一般弟子可以看到的，现在有机会看到自家的神子，一些弟子肯定要一睹芳容
“听说了吗，神子要下界历练了”
“听说了，家主刚刚就将这个消息传到我凌家所有人了”
阵法旁边两名身穿紫色道袍的凌家弟子道
“是啊，就担心会被外面的势力知道此次神子下界历练中途中，会派杀手暗杀神子”
“想啥呢？你以为我们凌家不知道会这样吗？家族肯定会派仙圣强者为神子的护道者”
“是啊，你也不想想，神子乃是我们凌家的希望，家族对神子的呵护胜过自己”
“哈哈哈也是”
阵法旁边的广场数十位凌家弟子都在议论着凌浩此次下界历练的事情，此次凌家神子下界历练肯定会惊动整个三千世界，以及一些敌对势力
天空上传来一阵阵兽声，震动整片虚空，虚空穿梭阵法四处都在震动，修为低下的弟子耳朵开始出血，甚至有的弟子撑不住纷纷倒下
天空上，一座如同城堡一般的座驾慢慢的出现在眼前，如同太阳般耀眼，整座座驾晶壁辉煌，前面乃是八只上古麒麟拉车，座驾的周边乃是六十四金甲帝卫
“我等见过神子，神子万安”
下面的凌家弟子纷纷单膝下跪恭敬道，不敢有丝毫怠慢
“诸位族兄族姐，无需多礼，请起”
凌浩走出座驾道，随着凌浩出现在世人的面前，步入眼帘的是一张娇嫩却俊朗的小孩，身材修长，皮肤白皙如玉，他的眼睛清澈透明，仿佛洞察万物，屹立在座驾之上，如同少年仙帝一般
“哇，我们凌家神子也太可爱太帅了吧，如此小的年纪就有如此魅力，长大还得了”
下面的凌家女弟子看着天上的凌浩，眼里充满了爱慕，口水忍不住的从眼角出流了出来
“是啊，我一定要努力修炼，争取做神子的小妾”
“美的你，那也轮不到你，哼”
下面数名凌家女弟子都目不转睛的看着座驾上的凌浩，脸上花痴二字写的满满当当的，如同虎目羊窝
“诸位族兄族姐，往后大家一定要努力修炼，为了之后的大劫做准备，守护好我凌家”
凌浩看着下面的族人不经意的想起了前世所发生的事情
前世所有的凌家族人，除了自己全死在叶辰的手里，甚至还有的族人以自身为引，冲上叶辰纷纷自爆，最后无一人成功，整个凌家血流成河，尸骨堆积成上，血染红了整个大地
这一世不会再发生了！！
“我等遵命！！”
content_en:
upper bound
Three Thousand Worlds Ling Family
void shuttle array
The two outer sect elders have been waiting for Ling Hao's arrival.
In the center of the huge square, thousands of Ling family disciples gathered, all waiting for Ling Hao's arrival. After all, the Ling family's divine son was not something ordinary disciples could see. Now that they had the chance to see their own divine son, some disciples would definitely want to take a look.
"Have you heard that the Son of God is going to the lower world to experience?"
"I heard it. The head of the family just passed the news to everyone in my Ling family."
Next to the formation, two Ling family disciples wearing purple robes said:
"Yeah, I'm worried that outside forces will find out about the Son of God's journey to the lower realm, and they will send assassins to assassinate the Son of God."
"What are you thinking about? Do you think our Ling family doesn't know this will happen? The family will definitely send a powerful immortal saint to be the protector of the Son of God."
"Yeah, don't even think about it. The Son of God is the hope of our Ling family. The family cares for the Son of God better than ourselves."
"Hahaha too"
Dozens of Ling family disciples in the square next to the formation are discussing Ling Hao's experience in the lower world. This experience of the Ling family's god son in the lower world will definitely alarm the entire Three Thousand Worlds, as well as some hostile forces.
Roar! ! roar! ! !
There were bursts of beast sounds in the sky, shaking the entire void. The void shuttle formation was shaking everywhere. The ears of disciples with low cultivation levels began to bleed, and some disciples even couldn't hold on and fell down one after another.
"The Son of God has arrived!!!"
In the sky, a castle-like vehicle slowly appeared in front of you. It was as dazzling as the sun. The entire vehicle was brilliant with crystal walls. In front of it were eight ancient unicorns pulling the cart. Surrounding the vehicle were sixty-four golden armored imperial guards.
"I have seen the Son of God, and the Son of God is safe and sound."
The disciples of the Ling family below all knelt on one knee and said respectfully, not daring to show any slights.
"Brothers and sisters, no need to be polite, please get up."
Ling Hao walked out of the car lane, and as Ling Hao appeared in front of the world, what came into view was a delicate but handsome child with a slender figure and fair skin like jade. His eyes were clear and transparent, as if he could see all things, standing on the car like a young immortal emperor.
"Wow, our divine son of the Ling family is too cute and handsome. He has such charm at such a young age. He will be better when he grows up."
The female disciple of the Ling family below looked at Ling Hao in the sky, her eyes filled with admiration, and her saliva could not help but flow out from the corners of her eyes.
"Yes, I must work hard to practice and strive to be the concubine of the Son of God."
"You're so beautiful, it's not your turn, huh"
Several female disciples of the Ling family below were looking intently at Ling Hao in the car, with the word "nymphomaniac" written all over their faces, like a tiger with eyes in a sheep's nest.
"Brothers and sisters, we must work hard to cultivate in the future, prepare for the catastrophe in the future, and protect our Ling family."
Ling Hao looked at the tribesmen below and inadvertently remembered what happened in his previous life.
All the members of the Ling family in the previous life, except for themselves, all died in Ye Chen's hands. There were even some members who used themselves as a guide to attack Ye Chen and explode themselves one after another. In the end, no one succeeded. The entire Ling family flowed into rivers of blood, piled up corpses, and the blood dyed the entire earth red.
It won't happen again in this life! !
"I will obey you!!"
